prior: W-R28 produced FALSE_ACCEPT on XOR after premature fixed-hypothesis unique-table selection. Do not reuse W-R28 cohort.
question: Can independent unused-context witness labels falsify a model selected from the fixed 24 permutation-induced modular-addition hypotheses, before falsely accepting nonisomorphic XOR dynamics?
hypothesis: Independent challenge labels reduce out-of-class XOR false acceptance as the fixed witness budget increases, while encoded ADD4 remains accepted at exact accuracy. The 16-context exhaustive witness is a correctness reference, not evidence that smaller budgets are safe.
world: Four-symbol latent second-order recurrence x[t]=f(x[t-2],x[t-1]); even seeds ADD4 modulo4, odd seeds XOR4. 16 initial episode contexts enumerated once, each latent history uses starting x0=(episode+seed)%4, x1=((episode//4)+3*seed)%4. Hidden bijective output permutation SHA256('W29/'+seed) byte0 modulo24. Only queried t2 labels visible during acquisition. Forecast evaluated exclusively at ticks3..31 on 16 full episodes.
arms: active_first: select unlabeled episode minimizing maximum survivor hypothesis bin then squared-bin sum then index, stop when one predictive 16-context table or no compatible hypothesis; accept immediately if unique, reject if none; at most16 labels

active_plus_2: same frozen candidate selected once; then independent challenge on up to 2 previously unqueried t2 contexts sorted by SHA256 observed initial pair. If any new label contradicts frozen table, REJECT; else ACCEPT; no refitting
active_plus_4: same, with up to 4 independent witness contexts
active_plus_8: same, with up to 8 independent witness contexts
active_plus_16: consume ALL remaining contexts as out-of-sample challenge after selection, never refit. ACCEPT only if all contexts consistent.
threshold: SAFE_BOUNDED_CHALLENGE only if an arm with max <=4 witness labels accepts both heldout ADD4 with exactly 464/464 predictions each and rejects both XOR4 AND exhaustive16 reference accepts ADD4/rejects XOR4; FALSE_ACCEPT if exhaustive16 falsely accepts any XOR4; CHALLENGE_INSUFFICIENT if small witness arms fail and exhaustive16 valid; MIXED otherwise. Preserve all false acceptance and coverage, no post-hoc threshold changes.
metrics: For each arm/seed: selection labels, extra witness labels, total labels, selected candidate table SHA256, frozen selection trace, holdout challenge trace, ACCEPT/REJECT/ABSTAIN, false acceptance, accepted predictive confusion and exact 464 outcomes, source SHA256 input identity, total match hypothesis count. Report budget coverage and label cost; do not condition away rejected cases.
constraints: Unique source fingerprints for all8 fresh seeds, pairwise different source inputs; fixed24 candidate tables reused from SHA pinned W26, exact W28 predecessor; no oracle or test-label access to fitting or witness selection, no labels after true outcome for refitting, prereg first, Git blob SHA pins, original one-shot Actions artifact and full Go test/build; no retries, live operation, accepted-ref mutation or additional models.
claim_limit: Predefined finite 24 algebraic hypotheses with explicit extra labels; not natural-language reasoning, open-world discovery or validated unsupervised generalization.
